subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets + widget authoring SDK

question: Should maintainers/security accept this cumulative dashboard stack and authorize the dependency/security-boundary changes for this exact head, or require a clean narrowed restack first?
rationale: The PR combines a new enabled-by-default dashboard plugin stack, an untrusted-widget sandbox surface, dependency graph changes, and open prerequisite PRs; automation can flag blockers but cannot choose product/security acceptance.

options.title: Repair and restack first
options.body: Require removal of the root scratch artifact, a clean base after prerequisites, dependency-guard resolution, and live chart proof before merge consideration.

options.title: Authorize the exact head
options.body: A maintainer and security owner can explicitly accept the dependency graph and sandbox/custom-widget surface for this exact head after review.

options.title: Pause for a narrower follow-up
options.body: Keep this PR paused until the dashboard substrate lands, then ask for a small chart/docs-only branch without inherited dependency churn.

recommendation.title: Repair and restack first
recommendation.body: Require removal of the root scratch artifact, a clean base after prerequisites, dependency-guard resolution, and live chart proof before merge consideration.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans bundled Control UI product direction and coordinating security/dependency review; he has the strongest adjacent ownership signal in current history.
